description.value: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} randomly shoots one of the following magical rays at a target it can see within 120 feet of itself (roll [[/r 1d10]]; reroll if the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has already used that ray during this turn):

1: Charm Ray. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=FiFw4GuYPxn03ejR]]. Failure: [[/damage 3d8 average type=psychic]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] condition for 1 hour or until it takes damage. Success: Half damage only.

2: Paralyzing Ray. Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=TtUh4QlSOSlBC0OG]]. Failure: The target has the &Reference[Paralyzed apply=false] condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

3: Fear Ray. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=16QQWxqfiNAfdBWD]]. Failure: [[/damage 3d6 average type=psychic]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Frightened apply=false] condition until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage only.

4: Slowing Ray. Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=hJd9urxEnTNGAFU3]]. Failure: [[/damage 4d8 average type=necrotic]] damage. Until the end of the target's next turn, the target can't take Reactions; its Speed is halved; and it can take either an action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both. Success: Half damage only.

5: Enervation Ray. Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=0mzurdlJQVtULOD9]]. Failure: [[/damage 3d10 average type=poison]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Poisoned apply=false] condition until the end of its next turn. While Poisoned, the target can't regain Hit Points. Success: Half damage only.

6: Telekinetic Ray. Strength Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=gyinHaY8uAPOAWdi]] (the target succeeds automatically if it is Gargantuan). Failure: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves the target up to 30 feet in any direction. The target has the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition until the start of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn or until the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has the &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] condition. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can also exert fine control on objects with this ray, such as manipulating a tool or opening a door or container.

7: Sleep Ray. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=xUx6KCivXmH9cCoB]] (the target succeeds automatically if it is a Construct or an Undead). Failure: The target has the &Reference[Unconscious apply=false] condition for 1 minute. The condition ends if the target takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it.

8: Petrification Ray. Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=RHN6jpVHV9Zf6JtW]]. First Failure: The target has the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. Second Failure: The target has the &Reference[Petrified apply=false] condition instead of the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition.

9: Disintegration Ray. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=y1zX9IWA0QKmgRYP]]. Failure: [[/damage 8d8 average type=force]] damage. If the target is a nonmagical object or a creation of magical force, a 10-foot Cube of it disintegrates into dust. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: If the target is a creature and this damage reduces it to 0 Hit Points, it disintegrates into dust.

10: Death Ray. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=T4Khsm4JJii5mIWw]]. Failure: [[/damage 10d10 average type=necrotic]] damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: The target dies if the ray reduces it to 0 Hit Points.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s central eye emits an imperceptible, magical wave of negative energy in a 150-foot Cone. Creatures in that area can't regain Hit Points until the start of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn. An intact Humanoid corpse there instantly rises as a Zombie under the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s control and takes its turn immediately after the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} on the same initiative count.
